_about: The kinds of opening event our sites already use (Tzvi, 29 Oct 2026: 'all your food wow moments are too similar'). Every idea in a build's IDEAS.md names one kind; scripts/check-ideas.mjs refuses an idea whose kind another site already uses. When an idea is chosen, add its kind here with the build's folder, so the next site cannot repeat it.

drop.what: the product, or something onto it, drops or falls into place

pour.what: a liquid is poured, drizzled or blended over or into the product

window.what: a window, ring, arch, cloud shape or pair of doors opens onto the product or photo

assemble.what: pieces fly, slide or are set in one by one until they build the product, an arch or a grid

burst.what: the product or its pieces explode outward

stickers.what: labels or stickers are stuck onto the product or photo

slats.what: bands, blinds or slats of colour swing aside to show the product

tumble.what: the product, cut out, turns or tumbles in 3D

untie.what: a ribbon, wrapping or lid is undone to show the product

journey.what: one film travels from where the product comes from to the finished product

dial.what: a knob or dial on the product is turned

snap.what: a solid piece is bent until it breaks in two; the instant freezes

strum.what: strings drawn across the screen are strummed and ring; the visitor plucks them

bulbs.what: the bulbs of a mirror or lamp come on one by one and light the scene; the visitor can switch them

wipe.what: a squeegee, cloth or blade wipes a misted or dirty surface clear in strokes to show the scene behind
